capabilities: Create symlinks to files inside and outside the vault
Create symlinks to folders inside and outside the vault
Create Windows junctions without admin privileges
extras: Desktop only; mobile unsupported. Creating symlinks can be dangerous and may cause data loss; some Windows symlink commands require admin privileges. Author states the plugin is in early development.
problem: Obsidian normally only works with files inside the vault, so users cannot reference external files and folders.
summary: Symlink tool that creates symbolic links and Windows junctions to files and folders inside or outside the vault.
